value.title: How you get in
value.body: Class 12 in any stream. Central and many other universities admit through CUET-UG; others admit on Class 12 marks or their own test. At many universities it is taken as one of the subjects in a general B.A. rather than as a single-subject honours.

value.title: At a glance
items: The degree alone does not lead to a government post — those come through competitive exams open to graduates of any subject.
Public Administration is an optional subject in the UPSC Civil Services exam, and much of the syllabus overlaps with general studies.
Private and non-profit routes include office administration, NGO and CSR programme work, and policy research.
Common next steps: an M.A. Public Administration, a public policy master's, an MBA, or civil-services preparation.
